design.name: 磐 curled-up scale ball (entrance form)
design.role: 磐出场演出的鳞球形态，单独模型，砸地后切换成本体
design.turnaround_lead: the pangolin hero from the sheet completely CURLED UP like a real rolled-up pangolin into a ROUND BALL: as wide as it is tall (a sphere about 1.15 m across, never an egg, pine cone or artichoke shape). The back scales cover the whole ball as on his back (same few big chunky bronze-olive scales with gold edges and the same dark tones as the sheet, thin glowing amber seams). His long broad scaled TAIL wraps once around the outside of the ball like a thick armoured belt running from the bottom up over the front, its tip tucked over the top, clearly readable as a tail; the top of his scaled head crest shows just under the tail tip. No face, arms, legs, clothes, gun or apron visible
design.turnaround_pose: ; the ball rests on its bottom on the ground. The tail belt must appear consistently in all four views (front: the tail runs vertically up the middle; side views: the tail curves over the front half; back: smooth back scales)
design.turnaround_digits: No hands, feet or face visible anywhere.
